name: Scan the list
health: Strong visual hierarchy; discovery and saved states remain unmodeled.
notes: Date, title, venue, time and price scan cleanly. Advertisement is clearly disclosed and visually distinct. This weekend, Albuquerque and Saved read as future discovery controls; the current static study has no filtering or saved-state behavior. Add dynamic event status only when needed; keep ordinary card density unchanged.

name: Open an event
health: Strong opening; attendance action needs a real destination.
notes: Full-screen photo and date/time/venue/price stay clear. Plan this evening currently scrolls to detail, matching the static study scope. Real events need a truthful primary action such as Get tickets, RSVP or Visit organizer, plus sold-out/cancelled variants. Save icon is a visual preview. Preserve the hero geometry.

name: Read the details
health: Good depth; practical trust and travel details are incomplete.
notes: Description, inclusions, schedule, age requirement and preparation guidance justify the detail page. Event ad is disclosed and below the introduction. Finding your way only has a city and a request to ask the organizer; the real product needs a street address or explicit undisclosed-location state, directions, named organizer/contact and factual access information. Add share/calendar and an honest ticket/RSVP link. These are omissions in a fictional static study, not defects in a live service.

name: Open the poor-photo version
health: Readable; additional image failure states need design coverage.
notes: The existing scrim preserves readable event information over the harsh flash snapshot. The full-height blank wall demonstrates the limits of automatic cropping. Next stress cases should include no image, failed loading, a wide photo, a text-heavy poster and an organizer-selected focal point. Fallback should use the approved dark texture and unchanged content structure. No different crop rule was tested here.
